assertions.assert: Each element (attention_bias_for_turn, model_facing_content) takes exactly its declared attributes, the required ones present and none empty, and no content, and the namespace has no other element: a malformed element raises error.execution and assigns nothing (its schema, package/cognition.xsd, rejects it before any run under scx validate).

<cognition:attention_bias_for_turn> writes the focus (the given focus when it is a configured device, else null) as the first candidate, then the stimulus's device (a bot.input's data.target_device, which the environment stamps on a device's input) when it is configured and not a candidate already; devices that are not an array raise error.execution and assign nothing.

<cognition:model_facing_content> writes the original's model-facing XML of the turn's input, indented as ElementTree writes it: <cognition:processor_input> holding host_input (a processing:input whose input is the stimulus, its data as content, stamped stimulus:event, then stimulus:id, stimulus:source and stimulus:target when set), prior_episodes and standing_directives with their counts, and the environment block, with failurelocation null.

Over one of the original's projection budgets (262144 encoded bytes, 4096 nodes, 4096 collection items, 65536 characters per scalar, and 65536 characters for the instructions; the instructions and the schema reserved first from the prompt's 262144 bytes, the projection rendering into what they leave), failurelocation receives the original's message and location null; without failurelocation the element raises error.execution and assigns nothing.
A stimulus that is neither an object with an event nor null, or episodes or directives that are not an array, raise error.execution and assign nothing.
